headline: Markets rebound 1% on buying in financial counters, rally in global peers; Sensex jumps 900 pts - OrissaPOST
summary: Sensex and Nifty rose more than 1% on bank buying and a positive global trend. Investors cited hopes of easing in the West Asia crisis ahead of US-Iran negotiations and lower crude prices.
why: The Sensex and Nifty are the two main benchmark equity indices of India, tracking the largest companies on the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange.
